## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

Game: "Emberfall Vale" — Stardew Valley but fantasy: a floating-island-ish fantasy valley with magic crops, enchanted forest, goblin/slime creatures, mana wells, a wizard shop, seasonal magic.

Must be complete and playable, 3D, phone/tablet. Core loop:
- Explore farm + village
- Till soil, plant seeds (3 fantasy crops), water, sleep to advance day, harvest, sell at market
- Chop trees / mine rocks for materials, fight slimes for essence
- Buy seeds & upgrades from wizard shop
- Quest/tutorial guidance
- Save/load localStorage

Visuals: Three.js low-poly with vertex colors, procedurally generated. Need to look beautiful: rolling terrain, lush colors, trees, mushrooms, crystals, glowing runes, water pond, cottage, windmill, fencing. Day/night with sky gradient, sun/moon, fireflies at night. Post-processing maybe not needed but could add bloom via UnrealBloomPass for fantasy glow. Mobile performance—cap pixel ratio, bloom optional/toggle. Use low-poly meshes, instanced grass.

Controls: virtual joystick left, action button right, camera rotate via drag on right side? For 3D farm game, camera follows player at isometric-ish angle with drag-to-rotate. Auto-target nearest interactable with a "Use" button, and show interaction prompt.

Simplify interaction: A single context action button that does the most relevant action at the tile in front of player: till, plant selected seed, water, harvest, chop, mine, talk, enter shop. Tool selection via hotbar at bottom (hoe, watering can, seeds, sword). On mobile, tap hotbar items. On desktop keys 1-5, E interact, Space attack.

Actually best: hotbar/action system:
- Tools: Hoe, Watering Can, Sword, Axe, Pickaxe? Too many. Use context-sensitive single "Interact" plus "Attack".
Simplify: The player automatically uses correct tool depending on target? Stardew requires selecting tools but for mobile accessibility, context action is good. Keep it simple and fun:
- Walk onto/near a farm tile: context action "Till" (if grass), "Plant [seed]" (if tilled + selected seed), "Water" (if planted & not watered), "Harvest" (if grown).
- Near tree: "Chop" (needs 2 hits) → wood
- Near rock: "Mine" → stone/gems
- Near slime: "Attack" (tap attack button) → essence
- Near NPC/shop: "Talk"/"Shop"

Resources: gold, wood, stone, essence, seeds inventory. Shop buys seeds, potions, backpack upgrades, sprinklers, magic watering.

Day cycle: time ticks; sleep at cottage bed or press "Sleep" button when near bed at night. Farm grows overnight if watered. Energy system: actions cost energy, potions restore; sleeping restores. That gives Stardew loop.

Combat: slimes wander in forest at night or always in forest. Attack button swings sword, damage nearby slimes, they drop essence. Player health, respawn if 0.

Vertex colors based on height/slope and patchiness. Collision via height sampling (player y = terrain height). Keep world bounded ~160x160 units. Farm plot area rectangular near cottage.

Coordinate system: world x/z, y up. Player moves on xz.

Camera: third person following with orbit yaw (drag horizontally) and fixed pitch ~45°, distance 18, smoothly follow. Orbit via drag on screen; joystick fixed lower-left. On desktop, mouse drag rotates, wheel zooms.

Farm tiles: grid 8x12 near cottage, each tile state: untilled/tilled, crop type, growth days, watered, ready. Represent visually with meshes: soil plane patches, crop models (stems + glowing fruit). Use small instanced? Only ~96 tiles, fine with individual groups; crops maybe 3 meshes each, up to 300 objects. OK but use merged geometry where possible. Simplicity over micro-opt; mobile should handle ~500 draw calls? Risky. Use instancing for fence, grass, trees partly. Let's aim for a few hundred objects max. Trees 60, each 3 meshes → 180. Crops: each tile creates a group; only active plots (max 96). Fine.

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser

  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements

  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button

  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D fantasy farming game inspired by Stardew Valley, targeting phone/tablet as well as desktop.

## Requirements
- 3D game, fantasy setting, phone/tablet support (touch controls, responsive layout, safe areas).
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.
- Screenshots for self-check must be small JPEGs with viewport ≤1280px wide; only the latest need be read.

## Decisions
- Stack: Vite + Three.js 0.160, procedural low-poly art, procedural WebAudio; no external assets.
- Game named **Emberfall Vale**; core loop: till/plant/water/harvest fantasy crops, sell to wizard shop, gather wood/stone/essence, clear slimes, sleep to advance days, awaken Moonwell, buy Ember Crown to win.
- Crops: Moonpetal (2 nights, 58◈), Sunberry (3 nights, 126◈), Starcorn (4 nights, 275◈).
- Controls: context-sensitive single Use button + attack; joystick on touch, WASD/arrows + E/Space/1–3/M on desktop; drag to orbit camera.
- Rendering: ACES tone mapping, bloom, 2048/1024 shadows, pixel-ratio cap; bloom auto-disables if FPS <26.
- Save key: `emberfall-vale-save-v1`; autosave every 20s plus actions/sleep.
- Start time 8:20 AM; title scene at 16:42 (golden hour); day advances 0.042 hours/sec; crops grow only if watered.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffold: `package.json`, `index.html`, `src/style.css`, `src/main.js`.
- 3D world: terrain, paths, farm grid, fence/gates, cottage, wizard tower, Moonwell shrine, pond with shader water, forest, rocks, crystals, flowers, mushrooms, floating islands, mountains, clouds, fireflies, smoke, rain, stars, day/night lighting.
- Player model/animation, third-person orbit camera, collisions (circles, AABBs, fence segments, pond, world radius).
- Farming interactions verified: till → plant → water → advance day → grow → harvest, energy costs, seed counts.
- Slimes with wander/chase/contact damage; attack logic with drops.
- HUD, joystick, hotbar, prompt/action labels, toasts, floating text, particles, quest tracker.
- Shop UI (buy/sell, seeds, potion, sprinkler, charm, crown), wizard/dryad dialogs, shrine UI, quest log/guide/options menu, sleep summary, win screen.
- Fixes applied: `mergeColored` normalization, gate light initialization, nested modal sheet fix, brighter daylight curve, rain auto-watering newly planted crops, force-rain flag, autosave, tutorial text, camera pitch 0.5.
- Screenshots reviewed: title, gameplay, crop field, shop, sleep summary.

### Active
- Verifying the latest patch set after reload and checking console for runtime errors.
- Mobile layout not yet tested/screenshot; portrait overlap between joystick/hotbar/action cluster still needs CSS.
- Shop “Locked” label replacement likely failed (grep for `Locked` returned nothing); verify/fix.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Reload the page, clear console errors, run `window.__game.startNew()`, capture a fresh 1280×800 gameplay screenshot with the new 0.5 camera pitch.
2. Verify rain auto-waters newly planted crops, shrine force-rain, autosave, and crown “Locked” label.
3. Add portrait CSS (hotbar raised above touch controls; adjust joystick/action sizes) and test landscape + portrait mobile screenshots.
4. Exercise shop buy/sell, quest completion/rewards, shrine rites, slime combat/damage/faint, save/continue, and night visuals.
5. Run `npm run build`, confirm production bundle works, and take final screenshots.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: game loop, farming, quests, shop, shrine, sleep, save/load, camera, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain/world geometry, farm visuals, interactions data, day/night/weather.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: HUD, modal/shop/menu/dialog/summary/win rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: all UI styling; portrait media query still needed.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: character model, animation, attack swing.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/slimes.js`: slime AI/combat.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural sound/ambience.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/util.js`: noise, geometry merge, glow textures, helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/HUD structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: bootstrap and error display.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: latest checks (`crops3.jpg`, `shop.jpg`, `summary.jpg`, `title6.jpg`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json`: Vite/Three dependencies and scripts.

## Important Context
- Dev server runs in tmux session `ember` on `http://localhost:3002` (`npm run dev`); Playwright browser session is already open. Use `playwright-cli resize 1280 800` then `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/x.jpg`.
- Debug hooks: `window.__game` and `window.__ember` with `teleport(x,z,facing)`, `use()`, `attack()`, `sleep()`, `advance()`, `setHours()`, `plots()`, `target()`, `shop()`, `addGold()`, `addEssence()`, `save()`.
- A localStorage save exists from testing, so the title may show “Continue”; call `window.__game.startNew()` for clean tests.
- Farm constants: 8×8 plots, tile 1.75, origin (-7,-7); spawn (0,8.2); shop tower (15.5,6.5); shrine (-16.5,5.5); pond (16,-14); wizard (18.6,8.4); dryad (-20.5,11.5).
- Summary/win/dialog templates were fixed to avoid nested `.sheet` wrappers, but not yet re-screenshot-verified.
- Known polish item: slimes can wander into the pond; gate lantern glow was reduced but still bright white.
- Working tree changes are uncommitted.

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
